raw.summary: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-114158 - Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
raw.details: ## Executive summary Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in .NET. This advisory provides guidance on updating affected applications and components. A Portable PDB `EmbeddedSource` record with parent RID 0 can trigger an out-of-bounds write. ## CVSS Details - **Version:** 3.1 - **Severity:** High - **Score:** 8.8 (base score) - **Vector:** `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:U/RL:O/RC:C` - **Weakness:** CWE-122 ## Affected Platforms - **Platforms:** Windows - **Architectures:** x86, x64, Arm64 ## Affected Packages Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native components bundled with the affected .NET versions listed below are affected when initializing the native reader with a crafted Portable PDB containing an `EmbeddedSource` record with parent RID 0. The Windows runtime's native stack-trace reader can reach this initialization through its native-reader fallback. ### .NET on Windows Product | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- .NET 8.0 installed on Windows | >= 8.0.0, < 8.0.34 | 8.0.34 .NET 9.0 installed on Windows | >= 9.0.0, < 9.0.23 | 9.0.23 .NET 10.0 installed on Windows | >= 10.0.0, < 10.0.15 | 10.0.15 .NET 11.0 installed on Windows | >= 11.0.0-preview.1, < 11.0.0 | 11.0.0 ### Windows runtime packages for self-contained applications The following packages deliver the affected .NET native reader. Exposure requires the PDB-reading operation described above; the presence of the reader does not make every application or symbol-reading path vulnerable. Package | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86) | >= 8.0.0, < 8.0.34 | 8.0.34 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64) | >= 8.0.0, < 8.0.34 | 8.0.34 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64) | >= 8.0.0, < 8.0.34 | 8.0.34 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86) | >= 9.0.0, < 9.0.23 | 9.0.23 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64) | >= 9.0.0, < 9.0.23 | 9.0.23 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64) | >= 9.0.0, < 9.0.23 | 9.0.23 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86) | >= 10.0.0, < 10.0.15 | 10.0.15 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64) | >= 10.0.0, < 10.0.15 | 10.0.15 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64) | >= 10.0.0, < 10.0.15 | 10.0.15 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x86) | >= 11.0.0-preview.1, < 11.0.0 | 11.0.0 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-x64) | >= 11.0.0-preview.1, < 11.0.0 | 11.0.0 [Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.win-arm64) | >= 11.0.0-preview.1, < 11.0.0 | 11.0.0 ### Windows SDK updates The following SDK updates include the corrected .NET runtime. Update each installed Windows SDK feature band: Product | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- .NET SDK 8.0.1xx on Windows | >= 8.0.100-0, < 8.0.134 | 8.0.134 .NET SDK 8.0.4xx on Windows | >= 8.0.400-0, < 8.0.428 | 8.0.428 .NET SDK 9.0.1xx on Windows | >= 9.0.100-0, < 9.0.124 | 9.0.124 .NET SDK 9.0.3xx on Windows | >= 9.0.300-0, < 9.0.321 | 9.0.321 .NET SDK 10.0.1xx on Windows | >= 10.0.100-0, < 10.0.115 | 10.0.115 .NET SDK 10.0.4xx on Windows | >= 10.0.400-0, < 10.0.404 | 10.0.404 .NET SDK 11.0.1xx on Windows | >= 11.0.100-preview.1, < 11.0.100 | 11.0.100 ## Advisory FAQ ### How do I know if I am affected? Applications using Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native components bundled with the affected .NET versions listed above to initialize the native reader with a crafted Portable PDB containing an `EmbeddedSource` record with parent RID 0 are exposed on x86, x64, and Arm64. The Windows runtime's native stack-trace reader can reach this initialization when PE metadata selects its native-reader fallback. See [affected packages](#affected-packages) for the affected .NET products on Windows. ### How do I fix the issue? Update affected .NET installations and each installed SDK feature band to the versions listed above or later. If an SDK was installed through Visual Studio, update Visual Studio as well. Updating a machine-wide runtime does not replace an application's embedded runtime.
